_about: Steelhead & salmon knowledge. Sink tips by water-temp band (F): heavy T-11/T-14 below about 42F, lighter as water warms; around 48-50F and up fish will rise to a fly near the surface (MidCurrent, Flylords, John Nagy). Flies by clarity. Edit freely.

tips.label: Heavy sink tip
tips.why: Cold water: fish hold deep and won't move far. Get the fly slow and low.

tips.label: Medium sink tip
tips.why: Cool water: fish will move a little. Keep the fly in the bottom third of the water.

tips.label: Light sink tip
tips.tip: T-4 to T-8, or an intermediate tip
tips.why: Prime temps: fish are active and will come up for a fly in the middle of the water.

tips.label: Floating line / dry line
tips.tip: Floating tip or a clear intermediate polyleader
tips.why: Warm water: fish are aggressive and will rise. Swing just under the surface or skate a dry.
